nodes.question: In the edited image, has the background been changed into a basketball court?
nodes.criteria: complete: the background depicts a basketball court, with visual context such as court flooring or markings and/or basketball-court equipment; a full-court view is not required. Basketball-themed objects alone, without the background depicting a court, are partial if they show progress toward the requested change. partial: some visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court, but the background does not yet depict one. absent: no progress toward this background change. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress.
nodes.binding: Assess whether the edited image background has been changed into a basketball court, using visible court context rather than basketball-themed objects alone.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
